set_up_treescope: set up treescope to render PyTorch tensors and modules by registering adapters and handlers
create_TorchTensorAdapter: create a TorchTensorAdapter instance to adapt PyTorch tensors for treescope rendering
render_torch_tensors: render a torch tensor as a foldable treescope tree with summary statistics and dtype info
render_torch_modules: render a torch.nn.Module as a foldable treescope tree with parameters, buffers, and submodules
summarize_TorchTensorAdapter_get_array_s: summarize a torch tensor with dtype, shape, mean, std, min, max, and gradient info
